The spectators should also have a good view of the proceedings, and the "gate" will also benefit the Association, which possibly is the reason for this hankering after race-courses as venues. In the Junior race I am afraid our team will be rather weak, as R.

Dan Patience beat Charles Smart for third place, while other runners to gain 1st class standard medals were Rod Patience, Syd Ring, Alf Taylor and Dick Tobin. Second class standards were gained by Afthur Allum, Tom Morrell, R.
